lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots; at least four distinct vertical columns are visible on the mid-lateral flank, each containing 3 to 4 identifiable local maxima with regular spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular nodes, most prominently visible in the column immediately posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal linear feature is visible along the superior third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in pattern frequency, moving from high-density, small-diameter speckling on the cephalic region to low-density, large-diameter circular nodes on the lateral flank.
